data.narrative:
AQT is a Series A quantum computing company founded by Rainer Blatt, Thomas Monz, and Peter Zoller. The valuation landscape includes 11 sector peers: 3 public companies (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS) and 8 private firms, with notable private peers including Quantinuum, IonQ, PsiQuantum, D-Wave Quantum, and SandboxAQ.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this valuation. The quantum computing sector contains only 8 private comparables total, and filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers yields fewer than 3 datapoints in any category. A traditional peer-median approach would require at least 3 comparable transactions or valuations at equivalent development stages; applying an all-sector median would introduce excessive noise given the wide dispersion in maturity, capital efficiency, and technology approaches across quantum platforms.

Without sufficient narrow-set peer data, this analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation range at this time. Future valuation work should rely on either: (1) emergence of additional Series A or Series B quantum computing transactions that establish clearer stage-specific pricing, or (2) bottom-up discounted cash flow analysis anchored to technology development milestones and market adoption scenarios. Key uncertainties remain the pace of quantum hardware scaling, path to commercial utility, and capital requirements to reach breakeven.
